description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeEducationService class within the OrangeHRM larger system. The class provides methods to get and set an EmployeeEducationDao object, encapsulating access to employee education data. It appears to be part of the service layer, handling business logic related to employee education within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationService
classes.description: Service class managing EmployeeEducationDao for employee education data access within the HRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducationDao
methods.description: Retrieves the EmployeeEducationDao instance, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: setEmployeeEducationDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeEducationDao instance, allowing dependency injection.
